title: The Small Garden
author: Xanthe Sterling
blurb: Emrys Reyes, a pastry chef whose café is three missed payments from gone, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must forgive the person in the mirror first before the festival ends.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
